title: Stargate psychic spy program made public
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Stargate psychic spy program made public, about 2017 at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: uh the Stargate stuff you know the psychic spy program was actually sort of rested from the government and made public

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels mentions Stargate, which he describes as a US government psychic spy program, meaning an effort to use people who claimed mental powers to gather intelligence. He says the program was more or less pried out of the government's hands and made public, which he places around 2017. He tells it as part of a wider point: if true, the government has been pushed into revealing strange programs it once kept secret.
